title: Started a New Job and Hate It? What to Do Next

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团活动、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的慰问品，以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我都在这里。

sentences.en: What happens when you land the job you thought you wanted and then realize it's all wrong?
sentences.zh: 当你得到你以为自己想要的工作，却发现完全不对劲时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: If you've ever started a new role and felt completely out of place, anxious, undermined, questioning everything, you're not alone.
sentences.zh: 如果你曾开始一份新工作，却感到完全格格不入、焦虑、被打压、对一切产生怀疑，你并不孤单。

sentences.en: In this episode, we're talking about the mental toll of hating your new job, the hidden role of workplace culture,
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将讨论讨厌新工作带来的精神消耗、职场文化的隐秘作用，

sentences.en: and what it takes to walk away with your confidence and your sanity intact.
sentences.zh: 以及如何在保住自信和理智的同时全身而退。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: You are so welcome.
sentences.zh: 热烈欢迎你。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, workplaces can be big and scary places to be, and it's understandable that we might feel a little bit out of sorts when we start a new job.
sentences.zh: 职场可能是一个巨大而吓人的地方，当我们开始一份新工作时，感到有些不对劲是可以理解的。

sentences.en: But we would quickly expect that to adjust and for us to feel, hopefully, like we were in the right place.
sentences.zh: 但我们很快会期望这种状态能够调整，并希望自己能感觉到像是到了对的地方。

sentences.en: But that's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非总是如此。

sentences.en: And today, I'm talking to a leadership consultant, Kelly,
sentences.zh: 今天，我将与领导力顾问凯利交谈，

sentences.en: about a very recent experience she's had that really has helped her to embody everything that she practices and she preaches.
sentences.zh: 聊聊她最近的一次经历，这真正帮助她践行了她所信仰和宣扬的一切。

sentences.en: It is a beautiful, curious, thoughtful, compassionate episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一期精彩、好奇、体贴且富有同情心的节目。

sentences.en: It's like a mini shot in the arm of self-belief and dignity and respect and self-compassion.
sentences.zh: 它就像是一针强心剂，能给人带来自信、尊严、尊重和自我同情。

sentences.en: And I think you are going to love it.
sentences.zh: 我想你会喜欢它的。

sentences.en: If you do, please do like, please do comment, please do subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢，请点赞，请评论，请订阅。

sentences.en: If you're listening as a podcast, please do follow the show.
sentences.zh: 如果你是通过播客收听的，请关注这个节目。

sentences.en: It's the kindest thing you can do for any content creator that you rate.
sentences.zh: 这是你能为你所欣赏的任何内容创作者做的最贴心的事。

sentences.en: Let's crash on.
sentences.zh: 我们接着聊吧。

sentences.en: Let's meet Kelly.
sentences.zh: 让我们来认识一下凯利。

sentences.en: And yeah, I just think it's a great episode and I hope you agree too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这是一期很棒的节目，希望你也这么认为。

sentences.en: I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后再见。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Kelly Marie Loveseat.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我只想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾凯利·玛丽·洛夫西特。

sentences.en: Hi, Kelly.
sentences.zh: 嗨，凯利。

sentences.en: Welcome along.
sentences.zh: 欢迎到来。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玛丽安。

sentences.en: So we have known one another since we were 11 years old, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 所以我们从11岁起就认识了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, I drove past our secondary school the other day as I went to visit somebody in the village and realised it had been far more years than I'd given it credit for.
sentences.zh: 是的，前几天我去村里拜访某人时开车路过了我们的中学，我意识到过去的年头比我想象的要多得多。

sentences.en: Yeah, we won't disclose exactly how many years.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们就不透露具体是多少年了。

sentences.en: Well, maybe we will.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许我们会。

sentences.en: I'm 43, you're 44.
sentences.zh: 我43岁，你44岁。

sentences.en: You were one of the old ones, weren't you?
sentences.zh: 你是年长的那批人，对吧？

sentences.en: You were one of the September babies.
sentences.zh: 你是九月份出生的宝宝。

sentences.en: I was, but it was good at the time because, you know, you were always the oldest in the year.
sentences.zh: 我是，但当时挺好的，因为你知道，你总是同年级里年龄最大的。

sentences.en: Now I would probably be the youngeSt.
sentences.zh: 现在我可能成了年龄最小的了。

sentences.en: Okay, so we have stayed in touch.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以我们一直保持着联系。

sentences.en: We have seen each other over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来我们一直有见面。

sentences.en: But recently you shared a Facebook post that was really honest and really resonated with me.
sentences.zh: 但最近你在Facebook上分享了一篇非常诚实且让我深有同感的帖子。

sentences.en: And it was around the theme of, oh, I started a new job.
sentences.zh: 它围绕的主题是，哦，我开始了一份新工作。

sentences.en: I realised it was not for me for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于各种原因，我意识到它不适合我。

sentences.en: And rather than kind of grin and bear it, kind of wallow in that pain or make the best of a bad situation, you decided a different course of action, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 你没有选择逆来顺受、在痛苦中煎熬或是将就着应付糟糕的局面，而是决定采取不同的行动，对吗？

sentences.en: Could you guide us through that?
sentences.zh: 你能带我们了解一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So actually what had happened was I'd worked in a company that I loved, absolutely loved.
sentences.zh: 事实上，情况是这样的：我曾在一家公司工作过，我很喜欢那里，绝对是非常喜欢。

sentences.en: I loved my staff.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的员工。

sentences.en: We built the culture and it was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们共同建立了一种文化，非常美好。

sentences.en: And then the client base was sold and we had to make all of our staff redundant.
sentences.zh: 后来客户群被卖了，我们不得不解雇所有的员工。

sentences.en: So I needed to find a new job.
sentences.zh: 所以我需要找一份新工作。

sentences.en: So firstly, I wasn't looking.
sentences.zh: 首先，我当时并不是在找工作。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes that's part of it is you aren't looking.
sentences.zh: 我想有时部分原因就在于你其实并没有在找工作。

sentences.en: So you aren't necessarily taking your own needs into account.
sentences.zh: 所以你未必把自己的需求考虑在内。

sentences.en: So I went and found another job that seemed on the surface like it would be the ideal job that I was looking for.
sentences.zh: 于是我去找了另一份工作，表面上看这似乎是我一直在寻找的理想工作。

sentences.en: But what actually happened is I realised, I'd say quite quickly, within six weeks, that perhaps the business wasn't a fit for me.
sentences.zh: 但实际发生的是，我意识到，可以说非常快，在六周内，这家企业可能并不适合我。

sentences.en: But I hadn't quite figured out in that six weeks why that was.
sentences.zh: 但在那六周里，我还没完全弄明白原因是什么。

sentences.en: So I decided I would stay.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定留下来。

sentences.en: Maybe it was just nerves.
sentences.zh: 也许这只是紧张。

sentences.en: Maybe it was somewhere different.
sentences.zh: 也许只是因为环境不同。

sentences.en: And that actually six weeks isn't a very long time to get used to somewhere.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，六周对于适应一个新地方来说并不是很长的时间。

sentences.en: But by the time we got to the end of 12 weeks, I had changed from being outgoing, talkative, excited, shiny, even, to being sad, flat, tired.
sentences.zh: 但到了第12周结束时，我变了：从原本的外向、健谈、兴奋甚至神采奕奕，变得悲伤、压抑、疲惫。

sentences.en: And there were two things that fundamentally changed it for me.
sentences.zh: 有两件事彻底改变了我的看法。

sentences.en: One, I did a day trip to Paris on my own.
sentences.zh: 第一件，我独自去巴黎进行了一日游。

sentences.en: And I walked around Paris and I had this moment where I realised that I deserved to be really happy and I wasn't.
sentences.zh: 我在巴黎漫步，那一刻我意识到我理应获得真正的快乐，但我当时并不快乐。

sentences.en: And it was quite empowering.
sentences.zh: 这相当赋能。

sentences.en: And then I went to Amsterdam for work, but for a conference.
sentences.zh: 然后我因工作去了阿姆斯特丹参加一个会议。

sentences.en: And I did some presenting and some hosting.
sentences.zh: 我做了一些演讲和主持工作。

sentences.en: And it kind of relit the fire of who I am.
sentences.zh: 这有点重新点燃了我是谁的火花。

sentences.en: So I came back and spent a week evaluating what was it that didn't work for me in the place that I moved to,
sentences.zh: 所以我回来后花了一周时间评估，究竟是什么让我呆的地方不适合我，

sentences.en: realised that fundamentally their culture and my needs were never going to balance out.
sentences.zh: 我意识到从根本上讲，他们的文化和我的需求永远无法平衡。

sentences.en: And I took the decision to set up my own company, hand my notice in and see where things took me.
sentences.zh: 于是我决定创办自己的公司，递交辞呈，看看事情会把我带向何方。

sentences.en: And we find ourselves here.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就到了这里。

sentences.en: So we do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, I mentioned in the comment on your post that actually I thought this would make a really powerful podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在你帖子的评论里提到过，我觉得这会是一期很有影响力的播客节目。

sentences.en: And I know that potentially feels quite exposing and quite new, but this is not something that doesn't happen to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我知道这可能让人感觉有些暴露和全新，但这并不是不会发生在别人身上的事。

sentences.en: You know, this can be more common than we think.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能比我们想象的更常见。

sentences.en: And I love your story of curiosity and reflection.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢你充满好奇与反思的故事。

sentences.en: And there was no judgment there that you applied to yourself.
sentences.zh: 你对自己没有任何评判。

sentences.en: There was no shame.
sentences.zh: 没有任何羞耻感。

sentences.en: It was like, oh, oh, I've noticed this thing.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，哦，我注意到了这件事。

sentences.en: And actually that's not helping me live towards my values, which are actually all of these things.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这无助于我践行自己的价值观，而我的价值观其实正是所有这些东西。

sentences.en: And so rather than fix myself, mould myself, meld myself to fit this situation, I'm actually going to do what I can within my control to make a change.
sentences.zh: 因此，与其勉强自己、塑造自己、迎合自己去适应这种局面，我不如在自己能掌控的范围内尽力做出改变。

sentences.en: And for you, that change was taking yourself out of that situation, letting that culture, that organisation carry on as they are, because it wasn't important to you to change that.
sentences.zh: 对你来说，这种改变就是把自己带出那种环境，让那种文化、那家机构照常运转，因为改变它对你来说并不重要。

sentences.en: It was just important that you recognised that was not a bit of you and it was not helping you thrive.
sentences.zh: 重要的是你认识到那不属于你，也无助于你蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: No, and I love to change cultures.
sentences.zh: 没错，我其实很喜欢改变文化。

sentences.en: In my previous place, we took what was quite a challenging environment and we built this amazing, amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 在我之前的地方，我们将一个相当具有挑战性的环境变成了一件非常了不起的事情。

sentences.en: And I would have loved to do that there.
sentences.zh: 我也很乐意在那里做到这一点。

sentences.en: But not everywhere is open to the sorts of culture that I love to work in.
sentences.zh: 但并不是每个地方都接受我喜欢在其中工作的这种文化。

sentences.en: And so it's not for me to pass judgment on that culture, but it is for me to go, if it can't fit with my, it's not your morals, is it?
sentences.zh: 所以这不是去对那种文化进行评判的问题，而是我要去思考，如果它无法与我的——这不是你的道德问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Because that makes it sound a bit sketchy, but there's a part of you inside that you go, this is the level that I can deal with.
sentences.zh: 因为这听起来有点草率，但你内心深处会觉得，这是我能接受的底线。

sentences.en: And there's the professional side, but also I'm a human with a family and needs and requirements myself.
sentences.zh: 这里有专业的一面，但同时我也是一个有家庭、有需求和需要的人。

sentences.en: And this is killing me.
sentences.zh: 而这正在折磨着我。

sentences.en: And so now I feel unfulfilled in both elements of my life and my partner, my kids, my dog, myself.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我在生活的两个方面都感到空虚：我的伴侣、我的孩子、我的狗、我自己。

sentences.en: We don't deserve and no amount of money is worth feeling not the best version of yourself.
sentences.zh: 我们不应承受这些，任何金额的金钱都不值得让你感觉自己不是最好的状态。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it was, I did feel frightened.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我确实感到害怕。

sentences.en: I don't want to sit here like the most confident person that ever did live and go, this was super easy for me.
sentences.zh: 我不想坐在这里装作有史以来最自信的人，说这对我来说超级简单。

sentences.en: When I did it, my insides went, oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 当我这么做的时候，我内心其实在想，哦，好吧。

sentences.en: But the overriding feeling was I was really proud of myself.
sentences.zh: 但占主导地位的感觉是我为自己感到骄傲。

sentences.en: And I'm also very fortunate because I was made redundant.
sentences.zh: 而且我也很幸运，因为我是被裁员的。

sentences.en: I have a bit of a financial security that not everybody has.
sentences.zh: 我有了一点许多人不具备的财务安全感。

sentences.en: So I also do recognise that I was able to move potentially quicker than some other people may be able to do because of their financial needs and requirements.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实承认，由于经济需求和要求，我可能比其他人能够更快地做出行动。

sentences.en: But the advice still stands in that you can do things over a period of time, but just have your plan in place.
sentences.zh: 但这个建议依然成立：你可以花一段时间来做准备，但一定要制定好计划。

sentences.en: I was just really fortunate that I was unable to think mine through, make a plan and enact it quite quickly.
sentences.zh: 我只是非常幸运，能够理清思路、制定计划并相当迅速地付诸实施。

sentences.en: But just because you can't enact it quickly doesn't mean you shouldn't enact it.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅因为你不能迅速付诸实施，并不意味着你不应该去实施。

sentences.en: You just have to do, again, what works for you in your circumstances.
sentences.zh: 你只需要再次做那些适合你当前情况的事情。

sentences.en: And I was really, really fortunate and I'm very excited.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常非常幸运，而且我也感到很兴奋。

sentences.en: And I think if something excites you, you should definitely explore it.
sentences.zh: 我想如果有什么事情让你感到兴奋，你绝对应该去探索它。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And I think it's, you know, really, even as we spoke before we hit record, this has really activated your drive system.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，正如我们在开录前所聊的那样，这真的激活了你的驱动系统。

sentences.en: And actually, what you nicely demonstrated with your hands like that is a psychology term called cognitive dissonance.
sentences.zh: 实际上，你刚才用手势很好地演示了一个心理学词汇，叫做认知失调。

sentences.en: And it's that actually, you know, they were there, you were here.
sentences.zh: 那就是，他们在那边，而你在这里。

sentences.en: And the amount of psychological effort and shift it would take for you to, maybe if you were really hating it and you were up here and they were down there,
sentences.zh: 要达到他们的高度，需要付出大量的心理努力和转变——也许如果你真的很讨厌它，你在这里，而他们在那里——

sentences.en: the amount of effort it would take you for bringing yourself to their level because they aren't going to move would potentially break you.
sentences.zh: 要把自己拉到他们的水平所需付出的努力，因为他们是不会动摇的，这可能会压垮你。

sentences.en: You know, and it's we've all got ability to to do a little bit of this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们所有人都有能力做到这一点。

sentences.en: But actually, if you're always having to do this or always having to do that, it's an indication that this is probably not the right space for you.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，如果你总是不得不这样做或那样做，这就表明这可能不是适合你的空间。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you I've tried to and I'm not always the best at this because sometimes life takes over.
sentences.zh: 我曾试着去做到这一点，而且我在这方面并不总是做得很好，因为生活有时会占据主导。

sentences.en: But you can only control what you can control.
sentences.zh: 但你只能控制你能控制的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: I can't control other people.
sentences.zh: 我无法控制其他人。

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 并不是真的能。

sentences.en: Not properly.
sentences.zh: 不能完全控制。

sentences.en: So I can only control what's within my sphere of influence.
sentences.zh: 所以我只能控制我影响力范围之内的事情。

sentences.en: So that's where I can make the changes.
sentences.zh: 那才是我可以做出改变的地方。

sentences.en: And if other things around me change as a result of that positively, then I I love that.
sentences.zh: 如果我周围的其他事物因此发生了积极的变化，那我会非常高兴。

sentences.en: And it actually brings me so much joy.
sentences.zh: 这实际上给我带来了极大的快乐。

sentences.en: But I've learned that I need to concentrate on what I'm capable of changing.
sentences.zh: 但我已经学会了，我需要专注于我有能力改变的事情。

sentences.en: And you do that with morality.
sentences.zh: 你是带着道德感去做这件事的。

sentences.en: And I very much believe a saying that I use all the time is lighting somebody else's candle doesn't make the room darker.
sentences.zh: 我非常相信一句我经常使用的名言：点燃别人的蜡烛并不会让房间变暗。

sentences.en: It makes it brighter and it does not take away from your light.
sentences.zh: 它会让房间更亮，而且并不会夺走你自身的光芒。

sentences.en: So I try and live that way.
sentences.zh: 所以我尽量以这种方式生活。

sentences.en: And I think if you bring your intention into those sorts of decisions, you don't hurt other people, because that's the other thing is I wanted to make all of these changes.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你把这种意图带入这类决定中，你就不会伤害别人，因为还有一点是，我想做出所有这些改变，

sentences.en: But I did not want to hurt anybody's feelings.
sentences.zh: 但我不想伤害任何人的感情。

sentences.en: I did not want to cause discomfort to anybody, even the the company that I decided to leave.
sentences.zh: 我不想给任何人带来不适，甚至包括我决定离开的那家公司。

sentences.en: I wish them all the beSt. And I genuinely believe in what they're trying to do.
sentences.zh: 我祝他们一切顺利。我真心相信他们在努力做的事情。

sentences.en: So I think you can exit out of situations with as much dignity as you can.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得你可以尽可能体面地退出各种处境。

sentences.en: That helps you not feel embarrassed or stressed and proud of yourself.
sentences.zh: 这能帮助你不会感到尴尬或压力，并为自己感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Again, you can control your own behavior.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，你能控制自己的行为。

sentences.en: And that's really important when you take these decisions.
sentences.zh: 当你做出这些决定时，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And I know that people's CVs and gaps on their CV, but also how long you've spent at a company can feel like, you know,
sentences.zh: 我知道人们的简历上会有空白期，而且你在一家公司待了多久，也会让人觉得，你知道的，

sentences.en: like you're going to get that apprentice Alan Sugar question.
sentences.zh: 就像你会遭遇《学徒》节目里阿兰·萨格那样刁钻的提问。

sentences.en: You know, why were you only there two months or, you know, what were you doing during that time?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，为什么你只在那儿待了两个月？或者，你在那段时间里都在做什么？

sentences.en: You know, and you need to feel like you've got to validate that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你会觉得你需要为之辩解。

sentences.en: And sometimes, especially people in aspiring psych roles might say to me, I feel like I need to be there for at least six months.
sentences.zh: 有时候，特别是那些渴望从事心理学岗位的人可能会对我说，我觉得我必须在那里待至少六个月。

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, it seems to be killing you.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，好吧，这看起来快要把你折磨死了。

sentences.en: Do you really?
sentences.zh: 你真的要这样吗？

sentences.en: Like, what about those shoulds, Kelly?
sentences.zh: 比如，凯莉，那些所谓的“应该”又该怎么说呢？

sentences.en: And, you know, the values that we apply to ourselves, but we think that we need to kind of live up to as well.
sentences.zh: 还有，我们加诸自身的价值观，我们觉得我们也必须去达到那种标准。

sentences.en: Could we talk to that?
sentences.zh: 我们能聊聊这个吗？
哦，百分之百。

sentences.en: So, all right.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧。

sentences.en: If you've got six jobs that you've only been in three months, people are going to start to question your commitment.
sentences.zh: 如果你有六份工作都只干了三个月，人们就会开始质疑你的忠诚度。

sentences.en: And actually, you have to start questioning your commitment or your evaluation processes before you take jobs.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，你在找工作之前，就得开始质疑自己的忠诚度或评估流程了。

sentences.en: But we're not talking about five or six.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在讨论的不是五六份。

sentences.en: If you've got one, the thing that you, I was going to say need, but it's not a need.
sentences.zh: 如果你只有一份，你所——我本来想说“需要”，但其实这不是一种需求。

sentences.en: Again, it's those shoulds again, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，这又是那些所谓的“应该”，对吧？

sentences.en: Is you have to find your narrative and get comfortable with that.
sentences.zh: 那就是你必须找到自己的心路历程，并对此感到坦然。

sentences.en: And also, I think now, do I want to work for somewhere where I can't be honest about the fact that a place wasn't right for me and I made a decision that was right for me,
sentences.zh: 而且我也在想，现在，我是不是想去一个这样的地方工作：在这里，我不能坦诚地说“这个地方不适合我，我做出了对我而言正确的决定”，

sentences.en: but I am committed to being at the right place?
sentences.zh: 但我同时又承诺会留在真正适合的地方？

sentences.en: Look at the rest of my CV where I've been at places six years, seven years, been made redundant from my last role that I loved or I'd have stayed.
sentences.zh: 看看我简历上的其他经历，我在一些地方待了六年、七年，我上一份我很热爱的、甚至打算一直做下去的工作是因为被裁员才离开的。

sentences.en: So these shoulds that we put in place, I think we have to separate them out.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些我们强加的“应该”，我觉得我们必须把它们分清楚。

sentences.en: Some we put on ourselves and some we should.
sentences.zh: 有些是我们加在自己身上的，有些是我们确实应该做到的。

sentences.en: We should be a good person and we shouldn't be hurting other people's feelings unnecessarily.
sentences.zh: 我们应该做一个好人，不应该无缘无故地伤害别人的感情。

sentences.en: Those are some quite solid shoulds.
sentences.zh: 这些是一些相当坚实的“应该”。

sentences.en: We need to pay our mortgage or we need to pay our bills.
sentences.zh: 我们需要支付房贷或支付账单。

sentences.en: So sometimes there are practical applications that need to take over.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候有一些现实层面的需求必须占据主导地位。

sentences.en: They are a should.
sentences.zh: 它们确实是一种“应该”。

sentences.en: Again, you can't really control that to a degree, but I should be somewhere for six months.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，在某种程度上你无法真正控制这一点，但我“应该在某个地方待满六个月”。

sentences.en: I like to challenge with evidence.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢用证据来进行质疑。

sentences.en: Where's the evidence for that?
sentences.zh: 这背后的证据在哪里？

sentences.en: Where are all the studies that show six months gives you such a better evaluation period than four or that a workplace won't judge you just as harshly for leaving after six months?
sentences.zh: 到底有哪些研究表明，六个月的评估期就比四个月好得多，或者说，一个职场不会因为你干了六个月就离开而同样对你严厉评判呢？

sentences.en: Because six months still isn't very long.
sentences.zh: 因为六个月其实也算不上很长。

sentences.en: We shackle ourselves sometimes and women do it more.
sentences.zh: 我们有时会自我设限，而女性在这方面做得更多。

sentences.en: There's a really interesting stat that says men will apply for jobs if they are 20% capable of the stuff that's in the job description.
sentences.zh: 有一个非常有趣的数据显示，如果职位描述中的要求男性有20%能胜任，他们就会去申请。

sentences.en: Women will likely, and this is all likelihood, wait until they're 80% capable of doing the job.
sentences.zh: 而女性通常——而且这仅仅是一种概率——会等到自己有80%的把握能胜任这份工作时才去申请。

sentences.en: And it's part of the reason why men have moved forward faster than women.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么男性的晋升速度比女性更快的部分原因。

sentences.en: Part of it's been all the things that have gone on in history, but they have this ability to not always take on what everybody else thinks when it comes to their jobs.
sentences.zh: 部分原因与历史上发生的一切有关，但他们在对待工作时，有一种能力，不会总是把所有其他人的想法全盘接受。

sentences.en: So they have been historically, and again, this sounds maybe a bit sexist, but it isn't.
sentences.zh: 所以从历史上看，而且话说回来，这听起来可能有点性别歧视，但其实并不是。

sentences.en: It's based on studies, is that we would do better looking at ourselves a bit more like that.
sentences.zh: 它是基于研究得出的，那就是如果我们在审视自己时能更像他们那样，我们会做得更好。

sentences.en: What do I deserve?
sentences.zh: 我应得的是什么？

sentences.en: Not what does the other company deserve, because I'll give them the very best of me.
sentences.zh: 而不是另一家公司应得的是什么，因为我会把最好的自己献给他们。

sentences.en: What do I deserve?
sentences.zh: 我真正应得的是什么？

sentences.en: Not what should I do?
sentences.zh: 而不是我“应该”做什么？

sentences.en: I've got enough shoulds in my life.
sentences.zh: 我生活中的“应该”已经够多了。

sentences.en: I've got kids.
sentences.zh: 我有孩子。

sentences.en: You know, there's a lot that you need to do there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你在那里有很多必须要做的事。

sentences.en: But this is the biggest should.
sentences.zh: 但这是最重要的一条“应该”。

sentences.en: You should be able to be happy at work.
sentences.zh: 你应该能够在工作中感到快乐。

sentences.en: That sounds like a really obvious sentence, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一句显而易见的话，对吧？

sentences.en: But the question that you asked me indicates that actually too many people don't put that should at the very top of their liSt.
sentences.zh: 但你问我的这个问题表明，实际上有太多人并没有把这条“应该”放在他们清单的最顶端。

sentences.en: And my last role before the one that I didn't love, I had 120 staff, right?
sentences.zh: 在我上一份我并不热爱的工作之前，我手下有120名员工，对吧？

sentences.en: If they weren't happy, I wasn't getting the best of them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不开心，我就无法让他们展现出最好的一面。

sentences.en: If my voice was the only path forward, they weren't able to be creative.
sentences.zh: 如果我的声音是唯一的行事方式，他们就无法发挥创造力。

sentences.en: You have to create an environment for your staff, for yourself, that allows you to fail fast and safely.
sentences.zh: 你必须为你的员工、为你自己创造一个环境，让你能够快速且安全地容许失败。

sentences.en: We get the best results by putting ourselves in situations that make us slightly uncomfortable because we push.
sentences.zh: 我们通过让自己处于稍微有些不适的情境中来推动自己，从而获得最好的结果。

sentences.en: But create an environment for yourself where it's okay if it goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 但要为自己创造这样一个环境：即使事情搞砸了也没关系。

sentences.en: Like, Marion, if I'd come to you and said, I really hate my job.
sentences.zh: 比如，玛丽恩，如果我来找你说，我真的很讨厌我的工作。

sentences.en: And, you know, the advice you would have given me, what I imagine would have been along the lines of, you deserve better, Kelly, and you deserve to be happy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你给我的建议，我想大概会是这样的：凯莉，你值得拥有更好的，你值得拥有快乐。

sentences.en: So would we have been as likely to give that same advice to ourselves, do you think?
sentences.zh: 那么你觉得，我们在对待自己时，是否也会同样倾向于给自己这样的建议呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，对，绝对会的。

sentences.en: And actually how we speak to ourselves can often be a sense of how others have spoken to us.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，我们对自己说话的方式，往往反映了别人过去对我们说话的方式。

sentences.en: So if we've been around lots of messages that are like, no, other people will think this or that, then we begin to internalise that ourselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们身边充斥着这样的信息：不，别人会怎么怎么想，或者会那样看，那么我们自己就会开始将这些内化。

sentences.en: But I loved what you said, we deserve to be happy at work.
sentences.zh: 但我特别喜欢你刚才说的那句，我们在工作中值得拥有快乐。

sentences.en: We're going to be there like 40, 50, 60 years.
sentences.zh: 我们要在那儿工作40年、50年、60年呢。

sentences.en: 152 years if they keep raising the retirement age, you and I will be working until we die.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不断推迟退休年龄，那就是152年，我和你得工作到死。

sentences.en: But you do deserve to be happy.
sentences.zh: 但你确实值得拥有快乐。

sentences.en: But also, if your workplace puts a lot of effort into making sure you're happy, they also deserve the best of you.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，如果你的职场花了很多精力来确保你过得快乐，他们也同样值得拥有最好的你。

sentences.en: And it becomes this mutually beneficial relationship where everybody wins, you know, like a win-win-win situation.
sentences.zh: 这就变成了一种互利共赢的关系，每个人都是赢家，你知道的，就像是一个三赢的局面。

sentences.en: And the more of those that we can create in life, the better off people are generally.
sentences.zh: 我们在生活中创造的这种局面越多，人们的整体状况就会越好。

sentences.en: I do quite a lot of coaching with women.
sentences.zh: 我做了相当多的女性教练辅导工作。

sentences.en: And one of the first things I try to get them to do is when we talk, they're like, I think.
sentences.zh: 我试图让她们做的第一件事之一就是，当我们交谈时，她们会说：“我觉得……”

sentences.en: Do you think or do you know?
sentences.zh: 你是觉得，还是你知道？

sentences.en: So let's have an honest conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们进行一次坦诚的对话吧。

sentences.en: So by saying, I think, we almost, as you said, we're putting self-doubt on ourselves or not demonstrating to others that we have conviction in the things that we're saying.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过说“我觉得”，我们几乎就像你说的，把自我怀疑强加给了自己，或者没有向别人表明我们对自己所说的话深信不疑。

sentences.en: So one of the very first things we can do is I will self-correct.
sentences.zh: 所以我们能做的第一件事之一就是自我纠正。

sentences.en: If I am in the middle of a sentence and go, I think this, I will stop and I will go, actually, I know this to be the case.
sentences.zh: 如果我在说一句话说到一半时冒出一句“我觉得……”，我会停下来，然后改口说：“事实上，我很确凿地知道情况就是这样的。”

sentences.en: So I'll use I think when I only think it.
sentences.zh: 所以我只在确实只是觉得的时候才用“我觉得”。

sentences.en: But I've tried over the last few years where I've worked really hard to build up confidence in myself and others, to recognise that even small things like I think or maybe I could.
sentences.zh: 但在过去的几年里，我一直在努力为自己和他人建立自信，去意识到哪怕是一些小细节，比如“我觉得”或者“也许我可以”。

sentences.en: Am I feeling that way or am I trying to make myself not too much for somebody, to project a less confident exterior so that other people can be comfortable?
sentences.zh: 我真的是这么觉得的，还是我在刻意压抑自己，以免显得对别人要求太多、刻意展现出一个不够自信的外表好让别人觉得舒服？

sentences.en: For example, I'm outgoing and I'm quite outspoken, but I can have a filter where it's needed.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，我很外向，也相当直言不讳，但在需要的时候我也会有所克制。

sentences.en: So I won't filter everything I say.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会过滤我说的每一句话。

sentences.en: I will in the right environments, but I've learned that actually I might not be for everybody.
sentences.zh: 在合适的场合我会过滤，但我已经明白，实际上我可能并不适合所有人。

sentences.en: And whilst I don't want anybody to dislike me or hate me, it's OK that I'm not for everybody.
sentences.zh: 虽然我不希望任何人不喜欢我或讨厌我，但我不是为所有人准备的，这完全没关系。

sentences.en: I'm not for every workplace.
sentences.zh: 我不适合每一个职场。

sentences.en: Every workplace is not for me.
sentences.zh: 每一个职场也并非都适合我。

sentences.en: I'm not for them.
sentences.zh: 我不适合他们。

sentences.en: Getting a bit comfortable with not having to be loved and adored by everybody.
sentences.zh: 逐渐习惯不必被所有人喜爱和崇拜的感觉。

sentences.en: Actually, you get this freedom that you've still got to be a good human.
sentences.zh: 实际上，你会获得一种自由，当然你依然得做一个好人。

sentences.en: So you can't go around being a horrible person and go, it doesn't matter because I don't care for people like me.
sentences.zh: 所以你不能到处做一个糟糕的人，然后说：“没关系，因为我不在乎像我这样的人怎么想。”

sentences.en: But actually saying to yourself, if I've been the truest version of me and that hasn't worked, two choices here.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你要对自己说：“如果我已经展现了最真实版本的自己，而这行不通，这里有两个选择。”

sentences.en: Stay, change and you get to pick a lane.
sentences.zh: 留下来，或者改变，然后你自己选择一条路。

sentences.en: But I'm really fortunate that I've had excellent support.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很幸运，我得到了极好的支持。

sentences.en: You mentioned my Facebook poSt.
sentences.zh: 你提到了我的那条Facebook动态。

sentences.en: That post made me cry, not because of what I'd written, because I was really comfortable with what I'd written.
sentences.zh: 那条动态让我哭了，不是因为我写了什么，因为我对写下的内容感到非常坦然。

sentences.en: But the support that I received underneath in the comments from people who I'd helped or people who'd watched me grow properly brought tears to my eyes.
sentences.zh: 而是因为我帮助过的人或看着我成长的人在评论区给予我的支持，真的让我热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: While I was in the middle of Disneyland Paris, you understand as well.
sentences.zh: 当时我正身处巴黎迪士尼乐园的中心，你也能理解那种感觉。

sentences.en: So that was a weird situation.
sentences.zh: 所以那真是一种奇妙的状况。

sentences.en: But putting yourself out there is really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 但是，勇敢地展现真实的自我，真的是非常非常难的。

sentences.en: But if you do it and you do it in the right way, actually, people are fundamentally good.
sentences.zh: 但如果你去做了，而且用正确的方式去做，事实上，人们本质上都是善良的。

sentences.en: When you speak in front of people, for the most part, they don't want you to fail.
sentences.zh: 当你站在众人面前发言时，大多数情况下，他们并不希望你失败。

sentences.en: They don't want you to not do well.
sentences.zh: 他们不希望你表现不好。

sentences.en: They want you to grow.
sentences.zh: 他们希望你成长。

sentences.en: So I think we need to sometimes work on being more comfortable with talking about achievements or things that we've done like deciding to set up our own company without feeling that we've also got to maybe belittle ourselves a bit just to make sure people don't feel uncomfortable with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，有时我们需要努力去习惯谈论自己的成就，或者我们做过的事——比如决定创立自己的公司——而不需要觉得我们也必须稍微贬低一下自己，好确保别人不会因此感到不舒服。

sentences.en: That's quite interesting.
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: And from a psychological perspective, I'm sure there's some very technical terms for it.
sentences.zh: 从心理学的角度来看，我确信有一些非常专业的术语来描述它。

sentences.en: But I do a lot of work on imposter syndrome and helping, especially women, identify that that is a big driver and sometimes why we don't do things.
sentences.zh: 但我做了大量关于冒名顶替综合征的研究，帮助特别是女性认识到这是一个巨大的驱动因素，也是有时我们不敢行动的原因。

sentences.en: So I would also urge people to do a bit of research on imposter syndrome.
sentences.zh: 所以我也会敦促大家对冒名顶替综合征做一些研究。

sentences.en: It's really interesting, actually, how the mind works in those instances.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在这些情况下，大脑的运作方式真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: But there are some really easy techniques that you can use to make sure that even if your inside feels it, your outside is able to not show it as much.
sentences.zh: 但有一些非常简单的技巧你可以运用，确保即使你内心深处有所感觉，你的外在也能不那么明显地表现出来。

sentences.en: And you do that a few times and then you're actually confident about it.
sentences.zh: 你这样尝试几次，然后你就会真的对此充满自信了。

sentences.en: It's the bit fake it till you make it.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的“假装直到你真正做到”。

sentences.en: But there's nothing wrong with that.
sentences.zh: 但这样做并没有什么错。

sentences.en: That's been going on since the dawn of time.
sentences.zh: 这种事从盘古开天辟地以来就有了。

sentences.en: You know, but don't break yourself to do it and be authentic with it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，但不要为了做到这一点而把自己压垮，同时要保持真实。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是这样的。

sentences.en: And, yeah, just allow yourself to feel.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，允许自己去感受。

sentences.en: We don't want you to feel overwhelmed, but having a gentle stretch, that feels good sometimes and actually allows us to then more comfortably grow.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望你感到不堪重负，但适度地舒展一下，有时感觉很好，实际上能让我们此后更加自在地成长。

sentences.en: And so it's, yeah, just thinking about actually being well supported during your growth phase.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，就是去思考在成长阶段能够得到良好的支持。

sentences.en: Like you said, you know, people around you, maybe it's, you know, people in your network, people in your family, maybe your friends, maybe,
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，你知道的，你身边的人，也许是，你知道的，你人脉圈里的人，你家里的亲人，也许是你的朋友，也许是，

sentences.en: maybe even people you meet along the way who are also carving out this space that you use them appropriately to help you to get where you need to be.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是你在路上遇到、同样在开辟属于自己天地的人，你要恰当地借助他们的力量来帮助自己到达你需要去的地方。

sentences.en: And then, like you say, you help the other people coming up behind you as well.
sentences.zh: 然后，正如你所说，你也会去帮助那些紧随其后成长起来的人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Do not tread on people to get where you need to go.
sentences.zh: 不要踩着别人的肩膀去达到你需要去的地方。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And some of what you were saying, it made me think about when you break up with somebody and you don't hate them,
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的一些话，让我想起了当你和某人分手时，你并不讨厌对方，

sentences.en: but you recognise that actually I'm not as happy as I think I could be, which therefore means you are not as happy.
sentences.zh: 但你意识到，实际上我并没有自己想象的那么快乐，这意味着你其实也没有那么快乐。

sentences.en: Even if you tell me you're happy, you are not as happy as I think you have the potential to be.
sentences.zh: 即使你告诉我你很快乐，你的快乐程度也没有达到我认为你所拥有的潜力。

sentences.en: Because if I was really, really, really happy, you would be even happier.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我真的、真的、真的很快乐，你就会更加快乐。

sentences.en: And so I want that for you, but I also want that for myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你快乐，但我也希望自己快乐。

sentences.en: And I think the same is true of workplaces.
sentences.zh: 我觉得职场也是同样的道理。

sentences.en: If you're there, middling along, hating every minute, looking at when it's one minute past five so you can run away, that's not helping the organisation to thrive either.
sentences.zh: 如果你在那里混日子，痛恨每一分钟，盯着表看是不是刚过五点零一分好马上逃跑，这对组织的发展也毫无帮助。

sentences.en: So even though recruitment can be a costly, lengthy, involved process, ultimately, it's better to kind of make those decisions that serve you better,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管招聘可能是一个成本高昂、漫长且繁琐的过程，但归根结底，做出那些对你更有利的决定更好，

sentences.en: that then help you to thrive going off in that direction, and the organisation to thrive, getting someone new in.
sentences.zh: 这不仅能帮你朝着那个方向蓬勃发展，也能让组织通过招募新人来获得蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: And maybe they can even get someone that was part of the previous recruitment to, you know, rather than starting again,
sentences.zh: 也许他们甚至可以找回之前参与过招聘的人，你知道的，而不是一切从头开始，

sentences.en: who then does really thrive and helps the organisation to get where it wants to go.
sentences.zh: 而这个人随后确实能蓬勃发展，并帮助组织实现其目标。

sentences.en: Oh, I couldn't agree more.
sentences.zh: 哦，我再赞同不过了。

sentences.en: And what I would like to say is there are options.
sentences.zh: 而我想说的是，我们其实有很多选择。

sentences.en: So I didn't just decide I hated it and just quit.
sentences.zh: 所以我不是那种仅仅因为讨厌它就决定直接辞职的人。

sentences.en: And I'm not very much of a quitter.
sentences.zh: 而且我其实很不轻易放弃。

sentences.en: But, you know, a lot of organisations are willing to look at new ways of doing things.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，许多机构都愿意尝试做事的新方法。

sentences.en: So being able to verbalise what you would like to see change and offering to help make that change is a really important step.
sentences.zh: 因此，能够把你想看到的改变用语言表达出来，并主动提出帮忙实现这种改变，是非常重要的一步。

sentences.en: But you can't flog a dead horse.
sentences.zh: 但你也不能强求做无用功。

sentences.en: So there is a level.
sentences.zh: 所以这还是有一个限度的。

sentences.en: But, you know, a lot of junior staff, especially, feel like they don't have the voice.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道的，许多初级员工特别是会觉得他们人微言轻。

sentences.en: But most workplaces do have staff forums, staff engagement surveys.
sentences.zh: 但大多数职场其实都有员工论坛和员工敬业度调查。

sentences.en: Then people will raise their eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 然后人们就会挑起眉毛。

sentences.en: But, oh, God, I've got to fill another one of those out.
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，我又得填一份这种表了。

sentences.en: So you do need to also recognise where your organisation is trying to make change.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实也需要认清你的组织正试图在哪些方面做出改变。

sentences.en: And if you want things to change, you can either moan about it and do nothing or you can step in.
sentences.zh: 如果你想让事情有所改变，要么就抱怨然后什么都不做，要么就亲自介入。

sentences.en: Most places now have women's groups, neurodiversity groups, colleague resource groups.
sentences.zh: 现在大部分地方都有女性小组、神经多样性小组、同事资源小组。

sentences.en: Be part of the change.
sentences.zh: 成为改变的一部分。

sentences.en: If you don't like something, you do have that option to be part of the process that improves things.
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢某事，你确实有选择参与改进过程的权力。

sentences.en: But it's important because moaning doesn't improve things.
sentences.zh: 但这很重要，因为抱怨并不能改善事情。

sentences.en: You can verbalise what is incorrect, but you need to also be able to verbalise what maybe you would do differently in order to make a change.
sentences.zh: 你可以用语言表达出哪里不对，但你也需要能够说出为了带来改变，你可能会采取什么不同的做法。

sentences.en: I always say to my staff when I take them on, I don't have very many rules, right, because I think rules are for driving.
sentences.zh: 我招员工入职时总是对他们说，我没那么多规矩，对吧，因为我觉得规矩是用来开车的。

sentences.en: OK, so one is please don't lie to me if something goes wrong, because one, I will find out.
sentences.zh: 好的，第一条是如果出了问题请不要对我说谎，因为第一，我一定会发现。

sentences.en: And two, you'll make more of a mess trying to clean it up and then I won't trust you.
sentences.zh: 第二，你试图掩盖只会弄得更糟，然后我就不会信任你了。

sentences.en: Tell me and we'll work our way through together.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，我们一起想办法解决。

sentences.en: If we keep making that mistake, we're going to have to address it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们一直犯那个错误，我们就不得不去处理它。

sentences.en: And the second one is be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 第二条是诚实。

sentences.en: And I don't mean as in you did something wrong.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是你做错了什么的那种。

sentences.en: If things aren't working for you, please tell me.
sentences.zh: 如果有些事对你不合适，请告诉我。

sentences.en: But with your honesty, I'd also like a suggestion.
sentences.zh: 但在坦诚的同时，我也希望你能提出建议。

sentences.en: So I don't have to be right all the time.
sentences.zh: 这样我就不用一直都是对的了。

sentences.en: I'm not the queen of the world.
sentences.zh: 我又不是世界女王。

sentences.en: So my team have the right to be heard.
sentences.zh: 所以我的团队有被倾听的权利。

sentences.en: But I also need to know what you would do differently.
sentences.zh: 但我也需要知道你会怎么做不同的尝试。

sentences.en: Because telling me you hate my idea, but having no other way of achieving it doesn't help.
sentences.zh: 因为告诉我你讨厌我的想法，却又拿不出其他实现途径，这毫无帮助。

sentences.en: And also that can be quite combative.
sentences.zh: 而且那也会显得很有对抗性。

sentences.en: Actually approaching it with, I hear what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 实际上，正确的态度是：我听到你说的了。

sentences.en: I have an alternative thought process I'd love to be able to discuss with you.
sentences.zh: 我有一个备选的思考过程，很想和你讨论一下。

sentences.en: Maybe we can find a middle ground.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以找到一个折中的办法。

sentences.en: You know, also it's not this idea or that idea.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这也不是非此即彼的想法。

sentences.en: Usually the best idea is this one that hasn't been invented yet, which is a combination of pulling in.
sentences.zh: 通常最好的想法是那种尚未被发明出来的、融合了各方观点的想法。

sentences.en: The other top tip for me, and I can't stress this enough, is do not surround yourself with people who are the same as you.
sentences.zh: 对我的另一个顶级建议，我怎么强调都不为过，那就是：不要让自己被与你相似的人包围。

sentences.en: Groupthink is a dangerous, dangerous, dangerous space.
sentences.zh: 集体思维是一个危险、危险、危险的温床。

sentences.en: I mean, if you want to surround yourself watching people watching, you know, Love is Blind on Netflix, super cool.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你想合围在一起看别人看，你知道的，像网飞的《盲爱》，那超酷的。

sentences.en: You need like-minded people.
sentences.zh: 你需要志同道合的人。

sentences.en: It's a fun time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段欢乐的时光。

sentences.en: If you want to create a brilliant atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 如果你想营造一个精彩的氛围。

sentences.en: So I'm very extroverted, which won't be a surprise to anybody I imagine on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我是个非常外向的人，我想这对这个播客上的任何人来说都不意外。

sentences.en: But how do I bring introverts into discussion points and make sure they're heard?
sentences.zh: 但我要如何把内向的人拉入讨论点并确保他们被听到呢？

sentences.en: It's my responsibility to set an agenda that allows them space to be spoken to.
sentences.zh: 我的责任是制定一个议程，为他们提供能够开口的空间。

sentences.en: I can ask probing questions if I feel that they're struggling to verbalize it.
sentences.zh: 如果我觉得他们难以用语言表达，我可以问一些探究性的问题。

sentences.en: Now they've gone quiet, I just let it go.
sentences.zh: 既然他们已经安静下来了，我就顺其自然。

sentences.en: So surround yourself with diversity.
sentences.zh: 所以，用多样性包围自己。

sentences.en: And I mean that in all shapes and forMs.
sentences.zh: 我是指各种形状和形式的多样性。

sentences.en: You can have the classic ones if you're a man, you're a woman, you're older, you're younger, you're black, you're white.
sentences.zh: 如果你是个男人，你可以有经典的那些：你是女人，你年长，你年轻，你是黑人，你是白人。

sentences.en: But I mean, people who think differently to you.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，那些思考方式与你不同的人。

sentences.en: It's the most enriching experience.
sentences.zh: 这是最丰富的体验。

sentences.en: My partner is Jamaican.
sentences.zh: 我的伴侣是牙买加人。

sentences.en: We've been together 18 years.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起18年了。

sentences.en: And prior to that, I had no understanding of that culture whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我对那种文化完全没有任何了解。

sentences.en: The moment I dipped my toe in the water, I loved it.
sentences.zh: 当我刚开始涉足时，我爱上了它。

sentences.en: And I have learned so many new things.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多新东西。

sentences.en: I can cook different dishes.
sentences.zh: 我可以做不同的菜肴。

sentences.en: I listen to entirely different music that's become some of my favorite.
sentences.zh: 我听完全不同的音乐，那些已经成了我最爱的一部分。

sentences.en: Because I didn't just end up surrounding myself with more people who are like me.
sentences.zh: 因为我没有最终只和那些像我一样的人混在一起。

sentences.en: And that can be frightening for some people.
sentences.zh: 这对某些人来说可能会感到害怕。

sentences.en: So if you're one that's able to do that, just spare a minute to try and create an environment for others who maybe can't do that with such ease.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是一个能够做到这一点的人，请抽出一分钟，试着为那些可能无法如此轻松做到这一点的人创造一个环境。

sentences.en: And I've done a lot of mentoring and I tend to mentor introverts because they're the ones who want.
sentences.zh: 我做过很多指导工作，我倾向于指导内向的人，因为他们是那些想要……的人。

sentences.en: I've tried to explain to people that extroversion also isn't just about being outgoing.
sentences.zh: 我曾试图向人们解释，外向不仅仅意味着性格外向。

sentences.en: So I'm actually more of an ambivert these days.
sentences.zh: 所以如今我其实更偏向于混合型性格。

sentences.en: So I fling between two, but I'll crash out if I'm not careful.
sentences.zh: 所以我在这两者间摇摆，但如果不小心我会崩溃。

sentences.en: And that's something I have to learn to manage.
sentences.zh: 这是我必须学会去应对的事情。

sentences.en: I'm not very good at that, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我在这方面不太擅长。

sentences.en: But introversion and extroversion has a lot to do with where you get your energy from, right?
sentences.zh: 但内向和外向很大程度上与你从哪里获得能量有关，对吧？

sentences.en: So this conversation will have energized me because I'm an extrovert.
sentences.zh: 所以这段对话会让我充满活力，因为我是个外向的人。

sentences.en: We will leave this and I'll be energized for the day.
sentences.zh: 我们结束这个之后，我一整天都会精力充沛。

sentences.en: An introvert will have maybe enjoyed it loads, but need to go and have a moment on their own or maybe an hour.
sentences.zh: 内向的人可能也会非常享受，但他们需要独自待上一会儿，或者也许是一个小时。

sentences.en: So recognizing that if you're doing a whole day event and you've got a load of introverts in there, you need lots of breaks and you probably need some food.
sentences.zh: 因此要认识到，如果你正在举办一整天的活动，里面有一群内向的人，你需要安排很多休息时间，而且可能还需要一些食物。

sentences.en: But, you know, adjusting things, it creates the culture.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，调整一些事情，这就能创造出文化。

sentences.en: And that kind of centrally brings us, doesn't it, back around to this whole culture of the workplace.
sentences.zh: 这从某种核心上把我们带回了整个职场文化这个话题，不是吗？

sentences.en: We're all responsible for it.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都对此负有责任。

sentences.en: The big boss is not the only one responsible for culture because they can't do it on their own.
sentences.zh: 大老板并不是唯一对文化负责的人，因为他们无法独自做到这一点。

sentences.en: They have to demonstrate the culture and verbalize the culture and create an environment for it.
sentences.zh: 他们必须展示文化、用语言表达文化，并为此创造环境。

sentences.en: But it's everybody's job in the workplace to work towards that culture.
sentences.zh: 但朝着这种文化努力是职场中每个人的工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah, honestly,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，老实说，

sentences.en: diversity is one of the biggest plus points to a workplace culture that I've ever found because it's so exciting to hear viewpoints you'd have never thought of yourself.
sentences.zh: 多样性是我所发现的对职场文化最大的加分项之一，因为听到你自己绝不会想到的观点是如此令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah, I love that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: And, yeah, even before we hit record, we were thinking about actually it's really lovely to have friends that are at different stages of their career,
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，甚至在我们按下录音键之前，我们就在想，其实能有处于职业生涯不同阶段的朋友，真的很美好，

sentences.en: different stages of kind of income, of wealth.
sentences.zh: 处于不同收入、财富阶段的朋友。

sentences.en: And like, you know, sometimes you've got a friend who might insist on going first class on a train.
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道的，有时你有个朋友可能会坚持坐火车的头等舱。

sentences.en: Sometimes you might go backpacking and stay in a hostel.
sentences.zh: 有时你可能会去背包旅行并住在青年旅社。

sentences.en: Like, it's really useful to have all those different viewpoints in our friendship circles and in our professional and family life as well.
sentences.zh: 就像，在我们的朋友圈以及职业和家庭生活中，拥有所有这些不同的观点真的很有用。

sentences.en: Like, I love the idea of, yeah, like finding a tribe who won't just say yes to you, but will challenge you and open you up to be curious and look at things in a different way.
sentences.zh: 就像，我喜欢这种想法：寻找一个不仅会对你说“好”，而且会挑战你、让你保持好奇并以不同方式看待事物的族群。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: So I had a couple of people reach out to me from my poSt.
sentences.zh: 所以有几个人通过我的帖子联系了我。

sentences.en: So my LinkedIn post did not go into any of my emotional requirements.
sentences.zh: 所以我的领英帖子并没有涉及我的任何情感需求。

sentences.en: It's not appropriate in my mind for that environment.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，那不适合那种环境。

sentences.en: My Facebook people is full of friends and people I've known throughout my life.
sentences.zh: 我的脸书里满是朋友和我在一生中认识的人。

sentences.en: But through the Facebook post, a couple of people reached out to me, one of whom was my sister.
sentences.zh: 但通过那条脸书帖子，有几个人联系了我，其中一个是我妹妹。

sentences.en: And my sister wasn't enjoying the job that she'd moved to.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹并不喜欢她跳槽后的工作。

sentences.en: And she asked for my advice.
sentences.zh: 她向我征求意见。

sentences.en: And I said to her, you already know what I'm going to say.
sentences.zh: 我对她说，你其实已经知道我要说什么了。

sentences.en: And that's why you've called me.
sentences.zh: 这就是你为什么打电话给我。

sentences.en: I just quit my job because I was miserable.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚辞掉了工作，因为我很痛苦。

sentences.en: So that's the advice you know I'm going to give you.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你知道我会给你的建议。

sentences.en: You have friends that you can go to who would give you the opposite advice, right?
sentences.zh: 你有一些朋友，你可以去找他们，他们会给你相反的建议，对吧？

sentences.en: But you haven't gone there.
sentences.zh: 但你没有去找他们。

sentences.en: So you already know what you're going to do.
sentences.zh: 所以你其实已经知道自己要怎么做了。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to tell you what to do because I'm not, that's not my job.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会告诉你该怎么做，因为我不是，那不是我的工作。

sentences.en: But what I'm going to say to you is, you've already told me what you want by reaching out to me.
sentences.zh: 但我要对你说的是，你通过联系我，已经告诉我你想要什么了。

sentences.en: She was like, oh.
sentences.zh: 她当时说，哦。

sentences.en: And sometimes I needed to be that honest, my sister, so I can be as honest as I want with her.
sentences.zh: 有时候我需要对我妹妹那么坦诚，所以我可以对她畅所欲言。

sentences.en: But I said to her, like, she needed, one of the things you can hand to people when they're struggling with their confidence is the ability to make the decision themselves.
sentences.zh: 但我对她说，比如，她需要，当人们在自信心挣扎时，你能给予他们的一点就是自己做决定的能力。

sentences.en: So I did.
sentences.zh: 所以我照做了。

sentences.en: I said, it's your decision.
sentences.zh: 我说，这是你的决定。

sentences.en: You know what I would do and you know what I did.
sentences.zh: 你知道我会怎么做，你也知道我做了什么。

sentences.en: And I would back you whatever.
sentences.zh: 无论如何我都会支持你。

sentences.en: And I think you're epic.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得你太棒了。

sentences.en: She's also just built a TikTok page for her plus size clothing that's hit 25,000 subscribers.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚还为自己的大码服装建立了一个TikTok页面，粉丝已经达到了25,000人。

sentences.en: So I said to her, you know you can do things.
sentences.zh: 所以我对她说，你知道你能做到很多事。

sentences.en: So she did that.
sentences.zh: 于是她照做了。

sentences.en: And then another lady reached out to me who was really struggling with her, her job and she didn't want to quit.
sentences.zh: 然后另一位女士联系了我，她对自己的工作非常苦恼，但又不想辞职。

sentences.en: I could tell by her message and it sounded like neither did the company want her to quit.
sentences.zh: 我从她的信息中能看出来，听起来公司也不希望她辞职。

sentences.en: So I coached her a little bit on what sort of conversation she could go and have and she did.
sentences.zh: 所以我稍微指导了她一下，看她可以去进行什么样的对话，她照做了。

sentences.en: And now she's had a promotion out of it and is able to influence things and is really much happier.
sentences.zh: 现在她因此获得了晋升，能够发挥影响力，而且快乐多了。

sentences.en: And I almost didn't post that because I was like, oh, maybe people think there's some self-pity here.
sentences.zh: 我差点没有发那条帖子，因为我想，哦，也许人们会觉得这里面有点自我怜悯。

sentences.en: And I was like, but there isn't.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，但并没有啊。

sentences.en: So it's fine.
sentences.zh: 所以没关系。

sentences.en: I like self-regulated that.
sentences.zh: 我对此进行了自我调节。

sentences.en: Ten years ago, I would never have put that post up because I wasn't able to self-regulate that way.
sentences.zh: 十年前，我绝不会发那条帖子，因为我当时没有能力那样进行自我调节。

sentences.en: But the tribe that you surround yourself with is important.
sentences.zh: 但是你身边的族群很重要。

sentences.en: But also take a bit of recognition to say, who did I go to for that?
sentences.zh: 但同时也要反思一下：我为了这事去找了谁？

sentences.en: Now, did I go to them because I had no other choice?
sentences.zh: 现在，我是因为别无选择才去找他们的吗？

sentences.en: That's different.
sentences.zh: 那性质不同。

sentences.en: But who are they and what does that actually mean I wanted from this conversation, really?
sentences.zh: 但他们是谁？这实际上意味着我从这次对话中真正想要的是什么？

sentences.en: And give yourself the value you deserve.
sentences.zh: 给自己应得的价值。

sentences.en: Yes, my advice is probably going to be great because it's what I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的建议可能很棒，因为这就是我所做的事。

sentences.en: And I'm pretty good at the work stuff and I'm good at the coaching.
sentences.zh: 而且我很擅长处理工作上的事，我也擅长指导别人。

sentences.en: But nobody knows you like you know you.
sentences.zh: 但没有人比你自己更了解你。

sentences.en: And so teaching people, again, I do predominantly speak with women, but that's just been, I think, because I did a lot of the women's group stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以教导人们——再次说明，我主要还是和女性对话，但这只是因为，我想，我做过很多女性小组的事情。

sentences.en: But that bit where you can self-recognize to trust this bit, you know, the little bit in there that speaks but has no mouth.
sentences.zh: 但是，当你有能力进行自我识别去信任这部分时——你知道的，里面那个会说话却没有嘴的小部分——

sentences.en: Teaching people to trust that part of their gut, to not assume the worst of themselves,
sentences.zh: 教导人们去信任他们直觉的那一部分，不要把最坏的情况套在自己身上，

sentences.en: to treat themselves like they would treat their best friend if their best friend was having this conversation with them.
sentences.zh: 对待自己就像对待最好的朋友一样，如果他们最好的朋友正在和他们进行这样的对话。

sentences.en: And, you know, don't belittle yourself.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，不要贬低自己。

sentences.en: People say to me, I'm just so stupid for thinking that.
sentences.zh: 人们对我说，我怎么会这么蠢去那样想。

sentences.en: Please don't.
sentences.zh: 请不要这样。

sentences.en: Please don't.
sentences.zh: 请不要这样。

sentences.en: I don't want to hear you're so stupid unless you just did something really stupid.
sentences.zh: 除非你刚刚真的做了什么很蠢的事，否则我不想听到你说自己很蠢。

sentences.en: You know, like the other day, put my lipstick in the fridge and I couldn't find it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像前几天，我把口红放进冰箱里，然后找不到了。

sentences.en: That was stupid, right?
sentences.zh: 那很蠢，对吧？

sentences.en: Because I meant to put the butter in the fridge and I don't know what happened.
sentences.zh: 因为我本打算把黄油放进冰箱的，我也不知道怎么回事。

sentences.en: That was silly.
sentences.zh: 那太傻了。

sentences.en: But we don't talk about ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但我们平时不会这样谈论自己。

sentences.en: I put the pineapple in the cupboard the other day and when I came back to it, I was like, yeah, this pineapple is no longer usable.
sentences.zh: 我前几天把菠萝放进橱柜里，当我再去看它时，我想，好吧，这个菠萝已经不能吃了。

sentences.en: See, that's a silly moment, right?
sentences.zh: 你看，那是个犯傻的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: But we can laugh at ourselves for it.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以为此嘲笑自己。

sentences.en: But when we're talking about our genuine skill sets, if we don't talk about ourselves with a certain level of care, not even confidence, because that's a whole different thing.
sentences.zh: 然而当我们在谈论自己真正的技能时，如果我们对自己缺乏一定程度的关爱——甚至不是自信，因为那是完全不同的另一回事——

sentences.en: And that, not everybody has that, but a level of care, you know, it's okay to say, I don't understand this or I'd like to learn more about that.
sentences.zh: 而且，并不是每个人都有那种自信，但需要有一定程度的关爱，你知道的，可以说“我不明白这个”或“我想多了解一下”，这其实是一种自我关爱，而不是说“我什么都不知道”。

sentences.en: That's really self-care and going, I don't know anything.
sentences.zh: 我永远什么都不会知道。

sentences.en: I'm never going to know anything.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你刚才对自己说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, what have you just said to yourself?
sentences.zh: 如果你的老师在12岁时对你那样说，你会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: And how would you have felt at 12 if your teacher had said that to you?
sentences.zh: 如果你12岁时老师对你这么说，你会作何感想？

sentences.en: Pretty crappy, I would say.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，可以说是相当糟糕。

sentences.en: Can I say that word on your podcast?
sentences.zh: 我能在你的播客里说这个词吗？

sentences.en: But you wouldn't have felt empowered, would you?
sentences.zh: 但你本来不会有那种充满力量的感觉，对吧？

sentences.en: So let's start by empowering ourselves, shall we, by being respectful at the very least, you know, and we'll work on all the confidence and building all the other things.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们从自我赋能开始吧，好吗？至少做到互相尊重，你知道的，然后我们再来培养自信和其它各种能力。

sentences.en: But let's respect ourselves enough to speak about ourselves as we deserve,
sentences.zh: 但我们要足够尊重自己，用我们应得的方式来谈论自己，

sentences.en: whilst making jokes about putting pineapples in fridges and lipsticks in freezers and all sorts of things, right?
sentences.zh: 同时开玩笑说把菠萝塞进冰箱、把口红放进冷冻室之类的各种事情，对吧？

sentences.en: But we can do that.
sentences.zh: 不过我们能做到这一点。

sentences.en: But be kind to others and yourself.
sentences.zh: 但要善待他人，也善待自己。

sentences.en: Don't tread on others as you.
sentences.zh: 不要像踩着别人一样去踩踏别人。

sentences.en: You know, like, I don't know if you've seen the vision where somebody's climbing
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像，我不知道你有没有见过那种画面，有人在攀爬，

sentences.en: and either you can have your foot on somebody's head or you can bring people with you on the journey.
sentences.zh: 要么你的脚踩在别人的头上，要么你在旅程中把大家一起带上。

sentences.en: That's your tribe.
sentences.zh: 那就是你的同路人。

sentences.en: If you bring people with you, the loyalty that manifests from that, if you've done it genuinely, is second to none.
sentences.zh: 如果你把大家一起带上，由此产生的忠诚度——如果你是真心实意的话——是无与伦比的。

sentences.en: Some of my colleagues, my ex-colleagues, have become genuine friends because we pulled each other along the journey.
sentences.zh: 我的一些同事，我的前同事，已经成了真正的朋友，因为我们是一路拉扯着走过来的。

sentences.en: When one was struggling, the other just stopped, held their hand, metaphorically most of the time,
sentences.zh: 当一个人遇到困难时，另一个人就会停下来，握住他们的手，大多数时候是象征性的，

sentences.en: but sometimes physically, and moved us through together, the people you surround yourself with are really, really important.
sentences.zh: 但有时是实际上的，然后拉着我们一起前进，你身边环绕着什么样的人，真的是、真的很重要。

sentences.en: It's not always easy, is it, especially in highly competitive industries.
sentences.zh: 这并不总是那么容易，对吧，尤其是在竞争激烈的行业里。

sentences.en: So, you know, a lot of the stuff I do for aspiring psychs, getting onto doctorate places, you know, sometimes there's only one job if it's an assistant psych job.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我为有志成为心理学家的人做很多事情，帮他们争取博士学位名额，你知道的，有时候如果是个助理心理学家的岗位，就只有一个职位。

sentences.en: And then it's really hard because you almost, you want to help them, but you also want to help yourself and you want to get there firSt.
sentences.zh: 然后这就变得很难，因为你几乎，你既想帮他们，但也想帮自己，想自己先到达终点。

sentences.en: And I think it becomes easier when you're going for a role where there might be 15 to 30 to 40 jobs.
sentences.zh: 我想，当你申请那种可能有15到30个甚至40个岗位的职位时，就会容易一些。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是的。

sentences.en: But yeah, it isn't always easy, but a lot of work I do is around, yeah, trying to encourage others, bring them along.
sentences.zh: 但对，这并不总是容易的，不过我做的很多工作都围绕着，对，试着鼓励别人，带上他们一起。

sentences.en: Don't see them as competition because one day they may be your colleagues.
sentences.zh: 不要把他们看作竞争对手，因为总有一天他们可能会成为你的同事。

sentences.en: They may still be your best friends, ultimately, you know, in 15, 20 years.
sentences.zh: 最终他们可能依然是你最好的朋友，你知道的，在15、20年之后。

sentences.en: It'll be nice to think, actually, I didn't elbow them in the side.
sentences.zh: 回想起来会觉得很欣慰，其实，我没有在背后肘击他们。

sentences.en: I brought them along with me.
sentences.zh: 我把他们一起带上了。

sentences.en: And recently there was an idea of someone said they were getting really behind and feeling really overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 最近有一个观点，有人说他们感觉自己真的落后了，而且压力极大。

sentences.en: And it's actually, no, we are calling you to come and join us where we are.
sentences.zh: 而实际情况是，不，我们在呼唤你来和我们一起加入我们所在的地方。

sentences.en: We're not judging you for where you are right now.
sentences.zh: 我们不会因为你现在的处境而对你评头论足。

sentences.en: Like, this is your call to step forward.
sentences.zh: 就像，这是你向前迈进的号角。

sentences.en: But I think listening to you and, you know, your conversation with your sister, you were really empowering herself to give herself permission to make that decision
sentences.zh: 但我觉得听你倾诉，你知道的，你和你姐姐的对话，你真的在赋予她力量，让她允许自己做出那个决定，

sentences.en: and validating that decision as well.
sentences.zh: 并且同时也对那个决定表示肯定。

sentences.en: You know, we invalidate ourselves so often.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们太经常否定自己了。

sentences.en: I was talking to a friend the other day who has had a series of awful things happen and was almost like, I don't know why I feel anxious.
sentences.zh: 我前几天跟一个朋友聊天，她经历了一连串可怕的事情，然后差不多是这种状态：我不知道为什么我感到焦虑。

sentences.en: I don't know why I'm not doing better.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我没有表现得更好。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, hold on a minute.
sentences.zh: 然后我就说，嗯，等一下。

sentences.en: We had this and this and this.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了这样、那样、还有那样的事。

sentences.en: And we've also got this.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还得面对这个。

sentences.en: I wouldn't expect you to be thriving and vibing and living your best self right now.
sentences.zh: 我可不指望你现在能意气风发、活力四射、过着最棒的生活。

sentences.en: Well done for breathing.
sentences.zh: 能呼吸就已经很棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: You're obviously still putting that pressure on yourself, not allowing yourself to be human and thinking that it's not OK to show your most honest, authentic self.
sentences.zh: 你显然仍然在给自己施加压力，不允许自己作为一个普通人存在，并且觉得展现最诚实、最真实的自己是不行的。

sentences.en: And I would say, certainly from our conversations today, it's OK to be authentic.
sentences.zh: 而我要说的是，从我们今天的交谈来看，做自己是完全可以的。

sentences.en: You're allowed to be human.
sentences.zh: 你允许成为一个普通人。

sentences.en: And, you know, I love that before we hit record, you were like, actually, this time in my life right now, I don't think I've ever felt better than I do right now.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我很喜欢在按下录音键之前，你说的那番话：其实，此时此刻我的人生阶段，我觉得自己从来没有像现在这样感觉这么好过。

sentences.en: And it's thinking, actually, that all the future might be really scary.
sentences.zh: 然后就会想，其实，所有的未来可能真的很吓人。

sentences.en: But, oh, my darling, what if the future's marvellous?
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，如果未来奇妙无比呢？

sentences.en: Oh, my God, it's that.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，就是这个。

sentences.en: That hits the nail on the head for me.
sentences.zh: 这简直说到我心坎里去了。

sentences.en: Like, why do we always assume it will be bad?
sentences.zh: 就像，为什么我们总是假设结果会很糟糕呢？

sentences.en: What if it's great?
sentences.zh: 如果它很棒呢？

sentences.en: And I was thinking about this as I was trying to go to sleep last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我正准备入睡时也在想这件事。

sentences.en: You know how that works, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道那种感觉对吧？

sentences.en: When your brain's like, hello, it's time to think.
sentences.zh: 当你的大脑开始运转：嗨，该思考人生了。

sentences.en: But society has a big part to play in that.
sentences.zh: 但社会在其中扮演了很大的角色。

sentences.en: So let's look at somebody like Adele.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来看看像阿黛尔这样的人。

sentences.en: When Adele was younger and bigger and was considered not as glowed up, let's say, people loved Adele and they revered her and she's this marvellous woman.
sentences.zh: 当阿黛尔更年轻、体型更胖、被认为还没有那么惊艳的时候，人们很爱阿黛尔，他们崇敬她，她是一个了不起的女性。

sentences.en: She loved herself and she was excellent at what she did.
sentences.zh: 她爱她自己，而且在她的领域里极其优秀。

sentences.en: But she decided she wanted to make some changes to herself, which is her absolute right as a human being.
sentences.zh: 但她决定对自己做出一些改变，作为一个人，这是她绝对的权利。

sentences.en: And I have seen, especially other women, berate her.
sentences.zh: 而我看到，特别是其他女性，在痛骂她。

sentences.en: Oh, she's fake now.
sentences.zh: 哦，她现在虚伪了。

sentences.en: Oh, she's, you know, she was one of the normal people and now she's not.
sentences.zh: 哦，她，你知道的，她以前是个普通人，现在不是了。

sentences.en: Really mean things.
sentences.zh: 全都是非常刻薄的话。

sentences.en: Why should a woman like Adele not be able to decide that she'd like to lose some weight and use some of the money she worked really hard to earn to glow herself up,
sentences.zh: 为什么像阿黛尔这样的女性就不能决定自己想要减减肥，并用她辛苦工作赚来的钱让自己变得更惊艳，

sentences.en: to make herself happy in a different format?
sentences.zh: 用另一种方式让自己快乐呢？

sentences.en: Yet you see social media, society, newspapers, they almost belittle her for it.
sentences.zh: 然而你看看社交媒体、社会、报纸，他们几乎为此贬低她。

sentences.en: Now, because she's Adele, she has all this support and all of this other stuff.
sentences.zh: 现在，因为她是阿黛尔，她拥有所有的支持和各种各样的资源。

sentences.en: But imagine you're just, yo, and this is what's happening to you.
sentences.zh: 但想象一下如果你只是个普通人，而这正是发生在你身上的事。

sentences.en: You're trying to improve yourself, but people are just chipping away at you.
sentences.zh: 你试图提升自己，但人们却一直在打击你。

sentences.en: And that's what happens sometimes is even society or social media or the way job specs are written that make it feel like it's not for you.
sentences.zh: 有时候发生的情况就是这样，无论是社会、社交媒体，还是招聘说明的撰写方式，都让你觉得这个机会不属于你。

sentences.en: Chip away at who we are.
sentences.zh: 一点点消磨掉我们的本色。

sentences.en: And sometimes people stay still because they think, I don't want people to think differently of me.
sentences.zh: 有时候人们原地踏步，因为他们想：我可不想让别人对我有不同的看法。

sentences.en: But we talked to think before the podcast started about intent, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 但在录播客之前我们讨论过意图，对吧？

sentences.en: And Adele's intent was to make herself feel better.
sentences.zh: 阿黛尔的意图是让自己感觉更好。

sentences.en: And I think she achieved that.
sentences.zh: 我想她做到了。

sentences.en: And I, I don't know the woman, but I feel really proud for her, that that's what she's been able to do in her life.
sentences.zh: 而且我，虽然我不认识她，但我真的为她感到骄傲，她能在自己的人生中做到这一点。

sentences.en: And it makes me sad when I see other people tearing her down.
sentences.zh: 每当我看到其他人把她拉下神坛时，我都会很难过。

sentences.en: And so over the years, I've really changed who I am.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的这些年里，我真的改变了自己。

sentences.en: Ten years ago, I may have posted something a little bit similar, partially through jealousy maybe, right?
sentences.zh: 十年前，我可能也会发一些类似的内容，部分原因也许是出于嫉妒，对吧？

sentences.en: Now I'm just thrilled.
sentences.zh: 现在我只有满满的兴奋。

sentences.en: Every time I see somebody do something like that, I'm thrilled for them.
sentences.zh: 每当我看到有人做类似的事情时，我都为他们感到高兴。

sentences.en: I saw pictures of Lizzo the other day, who's obviously also been on a journey.
sentences.zh: 我前几天看到莉佐的照片，她显然也在经历一段转变。

sentences.en: She's being vilified because she was proud to be a curvy girl.
sentences.zh: 她正在遭到恶毒的攻击，仅仅因为她曾为自己身为一个丰满女孩而骄傲。

sentences.en: And now she's a slimmer, curvy girl.
sentences.zh: 而现在她是一个更苗条的丰满女孩。

sentences.en: Doesn't mean she wasn't proud in both spaces.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着她在两个阶段都没有感到骄傲。

sentences.en: So sometimes you need to check the external factors.
sentences.zh: 所以有时你需要审视一下外部因素。

sentences.en: And that's a really big thing with the imposter syndrome phenomenon, whichever we like to call it, is actually sometimes it's not.
sentences.zh: 这正是“冒名顶替综合征”现象中非常重要的一点，无论我们怎么称呼它，其实有时候并不是你的问题。

sentences.en: Sometimes you are being made to feel less than.
sentences.zh: 有时是别人在让你觉得自己低人一等。

sentences.en: And a bad culture in a workplace is a really, not a bad culture, one that doesn't marry with yours necessarily.
sentences.zh: 职场中糟糕的文化氛围——也不能说糟糕，就是那种不一定与你合拍的文化。

sentences.en: That's a version of that.
sentences.zh: 这就是其中的一种表现形式。

sentences.en: And that's the thing we need to understand.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们需要理解的事情。

sentences.en: That is something chipping away at our confidence, chipping away at who we are.
sentences.zh: 那正是侵蚀我们自信、消磨我们本真的东西。

sentences.en: If we're having to pretend to be somebody else, it's where the misery comes from.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不得不假装成另一个人，痛苦就是这么来的。

sentences.en: So finding a culture that feeds you.
sentences.zh: 所以，去找一个能滋养你的文化氛围。

sentences.en: So 18 months ago, I was diagnosed with fibromyalgia.
sentences.zh: 18个月前，我被诊断出患有纤维肌痛。

sentences.en: And got a blue badge.
sentences.zh: 还拿到了残疾人停车证。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, my boss gave me my promotion.
sentences.zh: 两周后，我的老板宣布给我升职。

sentences.en: And I'd spent that two weeks worrying that my diagnosis would mean the promotion we'd been talking about and that I'd worked so hard for wasn't coming my way.
sentences.zh: 而那两周我一直在担心，我的诊断结果会意味着我们一直在谈论的、我为此付出巨大努力的晋升要泡汤了。

sentences.en: And what I got was a promotion and a flexible fortnight where I worked nine days out of every 10 to allow for my disability because I was honest and open and vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 而我得到的却是一次晋升，以及一个灵活的两周工作制——每10天里我工作9天，以此来迁就我的残疾，因为我既诚实、公开又展现了自己的脆弱。

sentences.en: And that was really hard for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的很难。

sentences.en: I'm generally quite confident.
sentences.zh: 我通常是个相当自信的人。

sentences.en: So one of my improvements that I'd like to make is sometimes I'd like to be able to be more vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 所以我想做出的改进之一，就是有时我希望能展现出更多脆弱的一面。

sentences.en: Hence my Facebook poSt.
sentences.zh: 这也是我发Facebook帖子的原因。

sentences.en: I have to push sometimes to share.
sentences.zh: 有时候我必须逼自己去分享。

sentences.en: But so much good came out of it when my dad died.
sentences.zh: 但在我父亲去世时，因此收获了太多的善意。

sentences.en: I took a new job two weeks later.
sentences.zh: 两周后我换了一份新工作。

sentences.en: I think mainly because I just couldn't be bothered to speak to my boss on the phone at the time.
sentences.zh: 我想主要是因为当时我实在懒得给老板打电话。

sentences.en: But actually I thrived.
sentences.zh: 但事实上我发展得很好。

sentences.en: Because somebody took the time to remind me in my moments of difficulty, they still believed in me.
sentences.zh: 因为有人花时间在我艰难的时刻提醒我，他们依然相信我。

sentences.en: And that's what a good culture does.
sentences.zh: 这就是好文化的作用。

sentences.en: When you're having...
sentences.zh: 当你经历着……

sentences.en: A good culture is great when everybody's great.
sentences.zh: 当所有人都顺风顺水时，好的文化自然很棒。

sentences.en: But what does your culture behave like when things aren't so great for you?
sentences.zh: 但当你的处境不太顺利时，你的文化会表现成什么样？

sentences.en: That's the real teSt.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的考验。

sentences.en: When you need to dip out.
sentences.zh: 当你需要抽身的时候。

sentences.en: When you need a moment.
sentences.zh: 当你需要喘口气的时候。

sentences.en: When you need the support you've been giving other people.
sentences.zh: 当你需要你曾经给予别人的那种支持的时候。

sentences.en: How does it pay you back?
sentences.zh: 它会怎样回报你？

sentences.en: And when my dad passed, my boss apologised for needing to call me but needed to offer the job and wanted it to go to me, you know?
sentences.zh: 在我父亲去世时，我的老板为不得不打电话给我而道歉，但因为必须把这个岗位定下来，而且她希望这个机会能落在我头上，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And she was as lovely as could be about it.
sentences.zh: 在这件事上她表现得体贴极了。

sentences.en: And actually it was the bit that made me go, you can't sit on this sofa being sad anymore.
sentences.zh: 事实上，正是这件事让我觉得：你不能再坐在这个沙发上自怨自艾了。

sentences.en: You can still be sad.
sentences.zh: 你依然可以难过。

sentences.en: But actually this is making it worse.
sentences.zh: 但这样下去只会让情况更糟。

sentences.en: So we underestimate culture sometimes until we really, really need it, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候我们低估了文化的力量，直到我们真正、真正需要它的时候，玛丽安。

sentences.en: And then it really comes into its own.
sentences.zh: 然后它才会真正大显身手。

sentences.en: And I have been, for the most part, actually incredibly fortunate to be surrounded by beautiful human beings who have had similar experiences to me and decided sharing them with me
sentences.zh: 而且，在很大程度上，我其实极其幸运，身边环绕着美好的灵魂，他们有着与我相似的经历，并且决定与我分享这一切、

sentences.en: and building me was more important than watching me suffer.
sentences.zh: 成就我，这比看着我受苦要重要得多。

sentences.en: And you can't put a price on that.
sentences.zh: 而这绝对是无价的。

sentences.en: Just can't.
sentences.zh: 真的是无价之宝。

sentences.en: That made me a bit teary but you can't put a price on that.
sentences.zh: 这让我有点想哭，但这种经历真的是无价的。

sentences.en: Relationships should be reciprocal.
sentences.zh: 人际关系应该是相互的。

sentences.en: It shouldn't be a one-way deposit scheme that you're never able to draw down on what you've put in.
sentences.zh: 它不应该是一个单向的储蓄计划，让你永远无法支取你所投入的东西。

sentences.en: And if it is, that is one-sided and that is not okay.
sentences.zh: 如果确实如此，那就是单方面的，这绝对不行。

sentences.en: That's almost like exploitive, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这简直有点像剥削，对吧？

sentences.en: Like it's not okay.
sentences.zh: 就像这样是不对的。

sentences.en: You should be able to lean on as well as be lent on.
sentences.zh: 你应该既能依靠别人，也能被别人依靠。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, the concept of an emotional bank account works really well here, both from a culture perspective but for yourself.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，“情感银行账户”的概念在这里非常适用，无论是从文化角度还是对你自己而言。

sentences.en: So if we think about a normal bank account, you go to work, you pay your money and your bills come out, you pay your money and your bills come out
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们想想普通的银行账户，你去上班，存入资金，然后账单扣款，你存入资金，账单扣款，

sentences.en: and it works in a really nice cycle.
sentences.zh: 它在一个非常美好的循环中运作。

sentences.en: If you stopped paying your money in and your bills kept coming out, eventually most normal people would be in deficit.
sentences.zh: 如果你停止存钱而账单不断扣除，最终大多数正常人都会出现赤字。

sentences.en: Once you're in deficit, it's a lot harder to build that back up again.
sentences.zh: 一旦陷入赤字，想要再把它建立起来就难得多.

sentences.en: Well, we give that credence to our finances.
sentences.zh: 你看，我们对财务信奉这一点。

sentences.en: So why do we not give that to our emotions?
sentences.zh: 那为什么我们不把它应用到我们的情感上呢？

sentences.en: If all you're doing is constantly paying out of your emotional bank account or others are constantly taking from it but you or others aren't feeding payments, you'll be in deficit.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直在从情感银行账户里支取，或者别人一直在不断索取，而你或其他人却没有注入新的存款，你就会陷入赤字。

sentences.en: And as soon as you get into deficit and that's kind of where I found myself a bit, right?
sentences.zh: 一旦你陷入赤字——而我之前差不多就发现自己处在这种状态，对吧？

sentences.en: It's really hard to bring yourself back out again.
sentences.zh: 要让自己重新走出来真的很难。

sentences.en: So it's really important to look at what is paying into your emotional bank account.
sentences.zh: 所以审视是什么在为你的情感银行账户充值，真的非常重要。

sentences.en: So my kids pay into mine and then they take out my actual bank account.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们为我的情感账户充值，然后他们又从我的现实银行账户里提现。

sentences.en: That's how having teenagers works, especially girl teenagers, like having a broke bestie.
sentences.zh: 养青少年就是这样的，尤其是少女青少年，简直就像养了个破产的闺蜜。

sentences.en: But you need to pay in.
sentences.zh: 但你得付出投入。

sentences.en: And so many people,
sentences.zh: 而且有那么多人，

sentences.en: parents are paying into so many places a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 父母在很多时候要在太多地方付出心力。

sentences.en: But actually they make the best employees if you look after them because they're used to balancing
sentences.zh: 但实际上，如果你照顾好他们，他们会成为最优秀的员工，因为他们习惯了

sentences.en: 962 different tasks in a day.
sentences.zh: 一天应对962件不同的任务。

sentences.en: So it's that.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样。

sentences.en: If we try and simplify things down, you can't drink from a well that's dry, your emotional bank account, there's plenty of things you could use.
sentences.zh: 如果我们试着把事情简单化，你是无法从一口枯井里喝水的，你的情感银行账户，有很多东西你可以利用。

sentences.en: But if you can sit back after listening to this podcast and do only one thing, and that is just evaluate your emotional bank account, the state that it's in,
sentences.zh: 但如果你在听完这个播客后能坐下来只做一件事，那就是评估你的情感银行账户，它的现状，

sentences.en: the payments that are coming out and the payments that are going in.
sentences.zh: 正在支出的款项和正在存入的款项。

sentences.en: Be clinical about it because actually taking the emotional bank account is a little bit easier.
sentences.zh: 要客观冷静地对待它，因为实际上，盘点情感银行账户要稍微容易一些。

sentences.en: But are these balanced for me?
sentences.zh: 但这些对我国而言平衡吗？

sentences.en: And if they're not, what do I want to do to adjust that?
sentences.zh: 如果它们不平衡，我想要做些什么来进行调整呢？

sentences.en: So actually sometimes you find the friendship circles you're in maybe aren't quite what you needed anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上有时候你会发现，你所在的社交圈可能已经不再是你真正需要的了。

sentences.en: And you can silently distance
sentences.zh: 你可以默默地疏远，

sentences.en: or maybe actually you enjoy running, but you haven't done it for months because you can't find the time.
sentences.zh: 或者也许你其实很喜欢跑步，但你已经好几个月没跑了，因为你抽不出时间。

sentences.en: Well, by finding that time, would that pay into your bank account and make these other withdrawals easier?
sentences.zh: 那么，通过抽出时间跑步，这会往你的银行账户里存入积分，并让其他支取变得更容易吗？

sentences.en: And that is what I implore people to do today if they could find 10 minutes to just evaluate your own emotional bank account and see if it's healthy,
sentences.zh: 这就是我今天恳请大家去做的事情，如果他们能抽出10分钟来评估一下自己的情感银行账户，看看它是否健康，

sentences.en: like you would do your budget spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 就像你对待预算电子表格那样。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And obviously, if people are watching this on YouTube, let us know in the comments what you're making of this, which bits are resonating with you.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果人们在YouTube上观看这个视频，请在评论区告诉我们你对此的看法，以及哪些点引发了你的共鸣。

sentences.en: Let us know, yeah, how your, you know, input and output is working for you, whether it's feeling fair.
sentences.zh: 让我们知道，是的，你的输入和输出对你来说进展如何，是否感觉公平。

sentences.en: Because, you know, we are passionate about this.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我们对此充满热情。

sentences.en: We believe this is really going to serve you well in your career, in your personal life, in your family life, in your friendship circles.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这真的会对你的职业生涯、个人生活、家庭生活以及社交圈大有裨益。

sentences.en: And we need to give ourselves permission to do these hard things.
sentences.zh: 我们需要给自己权限去做这些艰难的事情。

sentences.en: But also, like you said, we deserve to be happy at work, but in our relationships, in, in, you know, we get our ducks in a row.
sentences.zh: 但就像你说的，我们应该在工作中感到快乐，但在人际关系中，我们要把各种事情理清。

sentences.en: And I often think sometimes not all the ducks are uniquely aligned at any one point, but when they're out of line, that gives you an area for growth as well, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 我经常觉得，有时候并非所有事情在任何特定时间都完全对齐，但当它们错位时，这也为你提供了成长的空间，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, it does.
sentences.zh: 噢，确实如此。

sentences.en: Sometimes my ducks are pigeons as well.
sentences.zh: 有时候我的鸭子其实是鸽子。

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like they're all over the place, but that's okay too.
sentences.zh: 就像它们到处都是，但那也没关系。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: Like we get the most growth in our most uncomfortable times a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，我们在最不舒服的时刻获得最大的成长。

sentences.en: And if your ducks are a little out of alignment, that does make you feel uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 如果你的生活有点偏离正轨，这确实会让你感到不舒服。

sentences.en: What are you going to do to change that?
sentences.zh: 你打算做些什么来改变这一点？

sentences.en: I'd love to also see in the comments people's stories of where they've done something bold and sharing their experiences of, of bold feelings and how that's worked out.
sentences.zh: 我也很想在评论区看到大家的故事，关于他们做过的大胆举动，并分享他们对大胆感受的体验以及结果如何。

sentences.en: Or if you're in the middle of feeling something, sometimes just being able to get it from here to somewhere else is the first step in that journey.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你正处于某种感受之中，有时只要能把它从这里转移到别的地方，就是这段旅程的第一步。

sentences.en: And I've made it probably sound a lot easier than it was because we're talking about it in such a truncated amount of time.
sentences.zh: 我可能把它说得比实际容易得多，因为我们在如此短暂的时间内讨论它。

sentences.en: But if you take one step today and one step tomorrow, baby steps move mountains.
sentences.zh: 但如果你今天迈出一步，明天再迈出一步，积少成多，聚沙成塔。

sentences.en: It just takes time.
sentences.zh: 这只是需要时间。

sentences.en: But that's okay.
sentences.zh: 但这没关系。

sentences.en: That is so lovely.
sentences.zh: 这太美妙了。

sentences.en: But they do, you know, like sometimes we look at, oh, I haven't done very much since a year ago.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实会这样，你知道的，有时候我们会回顾，“哦，自一年前以来我没做成多少事。”

sentences.en: Well, why are we only evaluating a year ago?
