sentences.zh: 那么，为什么我们只评估一年前的情况呢？

sentences.en: Why don't we look at ourselves
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不看看

sentences.en: 10 years ago and see how absolutely far we've come?
sentences.zh: 10年前的自己，看看我们究竟取得了多大的进步？

sentences.en: You know, like when you're on a weight loss journey, if you only compare it to last week, it barely looks different.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像你在减肥的旅程中，如果你只和上周相比，几乎看不出什么变化。

sentences.en: If you compare it to a year ago, it's vaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它和一年前相比，那就是天差地别。

sentences.en: So that as well, like evaluate yourself against real criteria, not last week's criteria.
sentences.zh: 所以同样地，用真正的标准来评估自己，而不是用上周的标准。

sentences.en: It's not enough time because real change, emotional, physical, mental, workplace change, it's steps.
sentences.zh: 时间还不够，因为真正的改变——情感、身体、精神、职场上的改变——都需要一步步来。

sentences.en: It takes time.
sentences.zh: 这需要时间。

sentences.en: Be kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 善待你自己。

sentences.en: Be patient to yourself.
sentences.zh: 对自己要有耐心。

sentences.en: Put a little bit of pressure on yourself because as we talked about, it's healthy, but don't overpressure yourself and find a human who you trust implicitly to be your safe space
sentences.zh: 给自己施加一点压力，因为正如我们所讨论的，这很健康，但不要过度施压，去找一个你百分之百信任的人作为你的安全港湾，

sentences.en: so that when you are having a moment where you don't feel like you can do it and you will have them because normal people do, that you can go to that safe space,
sentences.zh: 这样当你有时候觉得自己撑不下去时——你肯定会有这种时刻，因为正常人都会有——你就可以去那个安全港湾，

sentences.en: verbalize your feelings so you're not holding it all in and then that wonderful human comes back to you and reminds you why you're doing this.
sentences.zh: 把你的感受说出来，这样你就不会把所有情绪都憋在心里，然后那个美好的人会回到你身边，提醒你为什么要坚持这样做。

sentences.en: They are invaluable.
sentences.zh: 他们是无价的。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think you are quickly becoming invaluable as well, Kelly.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得凯莉你也很快变得无价了。

sentences.en: I've loved our chat today and I would love if people have got ideas for future ways you'd like to hear from Kelly, let us know that in the comments as well.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢我们今天的聊天，如果大家对以后想听凯莉分享的内容有什么想法，也请在评论区告诉我们。

sentences.en: How can people connect with you?
sentences.zh: 人们怎么能联系到你呢？

sentences.en: How can people connect with you and, you know, work with you?
sentences.zh: 人们怎么能联系你并与你合作呢？

sentences.en: Are you on socials?
sentences.zh: 你在社交媒体上吗？

sentences.en: Have you got a website?
sentences.zh: 你有网站吗？

sentences.en: Guide us through all of that, Kelly.
sentences.zh: 凯莉，给我们介绍一下所有这些吧。

sentences.en: So I've just started all of that up.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚刚开始着手这一切。

sentences.en: So again, I wasn't particularly proficient with website building and AI tools because I hadn't used them before.
sentences.zh: 同样，我以前并不精通网站建设和AI工具，因为我以前没用过它们。

sentences.en: I was a sales director so I'm very human focused.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一名销售总监，所以我非常注重人际沟通。

sentences.en: So I've just set up a website.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚刚建立了一个网站。

sentences.en: It's under construction but I've set it up which is called
sentences.zh: 它还在建设中，但我已经把它建好了，叫做

sentences.en: lovesyleadershipcoaching.co.uk and there's a contact me page on there and I'm just building up a lot of the information now but I wanted something to be out there
sentences.zh: lovesyleadershipcoaching.co.uk，上面有一个联系我的页面，我现在正在完善很多信息，但我希望有一些内容能上线，

sentences.en: for people to be able to reach out.
sentences.zh: 以便人们能够联系到我。

sentences.en: I'm going to start putting social media stuff up.
sentences.zh: 我将开始发布社交媒体相关的内容。

sentences.en: So again, I would love to hear from people on what maybe they would like to hear from me.
sentences.zh: 所以同样地，我很想听听大家对我有什么想听的内容的建议。

sentences.en: So there'll be more and more coming along but check the website out.
sentences.zh: 所以会有越来越多的内容推出，但请查看这个网站。

sentences.en: This podcast has been a great step for building my new brand up and I will be looking to do some little seminars and things on things like imposter phenomenon on building
sentences.zh: 这个播客是我打造新品牌的一个很棒的起步，我期待着开展一些小型研讨会，探讨诸如冒名顶替现象、建立

sentences.en: your confidence on why it's okay to want to change yourself but still be really confident in who you are.
sentences.zh: 你的自信，以及为什么想要改变自己但同时对自己的身份充满自信是完全没问题的等主题。

sentences.en: So you've caught me at the very beginning
sentences.zh: 所以你见到我正处于

sentences.en: of my really exciting journey.
sentences.zh: 我这段激动人心的旅程的起点。

sentences.en: So yeah, I urge people to reach out, have a bit of a read and we can go from there and I'd love to hear from people.
